## Budget vs. Revenue

this is a short introduction to the analysis of the relationship between movie budgets and revenues. 

```{python}
#| label: fig-budget-revenue
#| fig-cap: "Movie Budget vs Revenue"
#| echo: true

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

plt.scatter(df["budget_musd"], df["revenue_musd"])
plt.xlabel("Budget (million USD)")
plt.ylabel("Revenue (million USD)")
plt.show()
```

@fig-budget-revenue shows the relationship between movie budgets and revenues.
